findings.problem: Worker is reaped before post-exit discovery of adopted descendants; cleanup covers known identities only. A child born between samples can survive unnoticed. Python audit hook is not proof about native forks. Plan explicitly names stat/statm only, whereas runner also reads own task/children; next plan must explicitly authorize narrowly scoped own/adopted PID metadata.
compliant ignores available wait4 and worker self maximum RSS. A measured peak above4GiB at exit can be labelled compliant if missed by parent samples.

Blocking wait4 and subsequent seal are not supervised by960s outer budget; outer_960s_compliant is only retrospective. Resolve honest unkillable/unreaped ownership vs lock lifetime without claiming hard closure or releasing while descendants live.

operation_counts uses only journal CAPTURE BEGIN. Backend catches observer failure and keeps foreground operations, so lost BEGIN plus successful END or loss of both can yield false render_exact0. Production operation_ledger must contribute loss-aware denominator/unknown intervals. Qualification currently rejects failures, but failure evidence remains inaccurate.
